pages.text: A stage is more than a number: it changes the space and tools available to you. The first five stages develop a $(thing)Kongqiao$(); stage six and beyond develop a $(thing)Xianqiao$() and personal realm. Every unlock preserves what came before.

pages.title: Stages 1–5 · Kongqiao
pages.text: $(li)Stage 1: 9 slots at normal stack size.$(li)Stage 2: 18 slots at 2× stack size.$(li)Stage 3: 36 slots at 4×, plus embedded crafting.$(li)Stage 4: 54 slots at 8×, plus embedded smithing.$(li)Stage 5: 72 slots at 16×, plus the embedded Immortal Furnace.

pages.title: Stages 6–8 · Xianqiao
pages.text: $(li)Stage 6: aggregated item storage and a personal realm with a 1-chunk radius.$(li)Stage 7: fluid storage, 3-chunk radius and 0.5×–4× time.$(li)Stage 8: FE, mana, source, chemicals and other external resources; 9-chunk radius and 0.2×–8× time.

pages.title: Stages 9–10 · Open Heavens
pages.text: $(li)Stage 9: 32-chunk radius and 0.1×–16× time.$(li)Stage 10: a rules radius of 1,024 chunks; time may be frozen or raised to 32×.$(br2)A separate safety cap limits force-loaded chunks. The playable boundary and storage rules still follow your stage.

pages.title: Advancement Is Explicit
pages.text: Stages one through four follow the lingqi bar. Stage five requires a valid Immortal Pill ascension. Later stages require a tribulation begun inside the owner's realm. Servers may lower the highest normal stage or replace enemies; this book states the defaults.
